scope: Read-only conservative lexical relative-import closure of the original P03, including import-type and conditional literal dynamic imports. This inventory is not runtime coverage or a passing test result.

method.algorithm: Breadth-first traversal of relative static import/export, side-effect imports, literal import() and require() specifiers. Type import expressions included and classified separately after source inspection.
method.resolution: Resolve literal paths against the importing directory. Exact paths, .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.json and index.ts/index.tsx candidates were checked against the complete W Sucafinav1 Git tree. No unresolved relative import remains.
method.local_operations: JSON parsing, lexical traversal, SHA-1 Git-blob recomputation, and writing inspection copies only. No dependency installation, product import, test, typecheck, guard or benchmark.
method.blob_verification: All 142 fetched source contents rehashed as SHA1('blob '+UTF8.length+'\0'+UTF8) with Python; 0 mismatches versus W Git tree metadata.

oracle_preservation.qualification: Static preservation verified; hosted runtime result recorded separately by root.

configuration.verification: Git tree identity only; no content execution

package_pins.name: @orchestra/sucafina
package_pins.description: Native Sucafina business module for Orchestra-SF.

conditional_asset.verification: W tree identity; not extracted or executed

omni.expected_control: one nonce-matched pass or not applicable verdict; no declaring test implies not applicable and no Omni product proof
omni.boundary: Preload has constant-directed import(expectations) resolving packages/core/test/fixture/omni-expect, plus literal core flag/omni imports. Their full graph is outside the P03 relative-import closure. Entire W root and config blobs pin their identity.

limitations: Conservative source closure includes types and conditional branches that P03 may never load or execute; file presence is not coverage.
Lexical source inventory is not a TypeScript compiler result; every matched import is resolved and source lines were checked, but typechecks remain owner45.

Nonrelative builtins are supplied by the hosted Bun/Node runtime; external npm/workspace packages are bounded by package manifests and the exact bun.lock, not recursively inventoried under node_modules.

The seven @orchestra/core/effect imports from product/contracts/runtime.ts are explicitly type-only. Optional workbook/report library imports are conditional. No financial producer was mocked or replaced by this inventory.
Nonliteral imports were not found in the P03 conservative relative closure; the separate Omni preload has a constant-directed dynamic import noted above.
Hosted images, setup actions, dependency caches and downloaded binaries require the actual run logs for execution provenance. This manifest does not transform config pins into successful execution.
Parent source branch and sf2-stack were not changed by this audit. All generated files are scratch inspection artifacts.
